tomas-where.label: tomas: Did you leave the pass at any point during service?

data.answer: No. Eight o'clock to the moment that plate went out, I was on the pass. I call the tickets, I bump the tickets, I don't get to leave. Chef, on the other hand, walked off in the middle of the push, about twenty to nine, and was gone a good ten minutes. Ask her where.
